category_title: 8-year-old student with ADHD (Combined Type) exhibiting disruptive classroom behaviors and social-emotional challenges
minimal_context: Alex and the tutor are sitting one-on-one at home to complete his daily homework assignments.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to sit down and complete your homework assignments for today.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't have any homework today. I lost my assignments anyway.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I have your worksheet right here. Please look at it and start working.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands beside the desk and quickly scribbles down a few answers) There, I'm done. I skipped the rest.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You have a lot of missing answers and mistakes. You need to sit back down and finish the whole page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Becomes tearful) I can't do it! I'm just a bad kid! I'm very bad and my mom is going to send me to another country!
